headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, led by Sal Stewart's 4-hit, 1-home run game. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-3, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save. The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, with Joe Ryan earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Hurston Waldrep (Atlanta Braves), who was transferred to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow surgery. Victor Vodnik (Colorado Rockies) was placed on the 15-day injured list with right ulnar nerve inflammation. Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays) was placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, with a low back strain.

The Cincinnati Reds traded Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, behind a strong performance from their offense. Sal Stewart led the charge with a 4-hit, 1-home run game, including a key homer that scored JJ Bleday.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 5-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Twins in 4-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, with Joe Ryan earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. Ryan Kreidler led the Astros' offense with a 1-for-3 performance, including a 3-run home run.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Rockies in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Colorado Rockies, with Jacob Latz earning the win after pitching 2.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and no earned runs. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their latest matchup. Patrick Bailey, Brayan Rocchio, and Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense, while Joey Cantillo made a significant impact on the mound.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with key performances from Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna. Braxton Ashcraft and Dustin May led the Pirates' pitching effort.

top_news.title: **Braves' Hurston Waldrep Undergoes Elbow Surgery**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Hurston Waldrep has been transferred to the 60-day injured list after undergoing right elbow surgery.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire Right-Hander Zach McCambley**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in exchange for outfielder Rece Hinds.
